work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Apostolic letter CLXI raises Count Girolamo Riccini’s Valle Pietra estate to a marquisate with succession; derogations and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF30919–30919; the source dating clause at LF31050–31053 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima secunda iunii millesimo ‘octingentesimo quadragesimo secundo, ponti- ficatus Nostri anno decimo secundo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
